verdict.rationale: Lago documents an official Rust MCP server that gives AI assistants like Claude direct access to its billing data. Its OpenAPI 3.1 schema is explicitly positioned for exposing billing actions to an AI agent, and a probe confirms the schema is live. Related agent tooling, including the Dunning Agent reading twelve months of invoices and payments and the overdue-invoice filters, covers the delinquent-accounts and customer-invoices parts of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that agents can query MRR or upcoming renewals, a list of the MCP tools/resources exposed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent querying.
